---
title: inif.indexed
description: Indexed archive format — incremental writes, header-only reads, random sample access.
reference: inif.indexed
---

The single-file indexed archive (`.inif`) stores metadata and sequences
once, then writes each sample as a separate compressed member. Readers can
load the header, summaries, one sample, or all samples without inflating
the entire document up front.

See [Saving and loading](../workflows/io.qmd#indexed-archive) for the
narrative overview.
